brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，把每个目标变成要的样子。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns each goal into the one wanted.

hint.zh: 还差的是让「或者」到「并且」底下去。
hint.en: What is left is to bring every “or” under the “and”s.

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>：否定范式，并且「或者」都在「并且」底下，几串「或者」用「并且」连起来。每一串「或者」叫一个<wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <wiki-ref to="cnf"></wiki-ref>: negation normal form, with every “or” under the “and”s, a few strings of “or” joined by “and”. Each string of “or” is a <wiki-ref to="clause"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: 自动证明器动手之前，通常先把句子化成合取范式。
after.en: Automatic provers usually bring a sentence to conjunctive normal form before anything else.
